name: Local headless browser (Playwright or Chrome)
what: A local command that opens a page in a headless browser and writes a screenshot file. It captures a coded design at each width of the view matrix and in each color scheme, for the rendered review. It runs on the user's machine, sends nothing out and spends nothing.
install: npx playwright install chromium (once), then npx playwright screenshot. A local Chrome or Chromium binary with --headless=new --screenshot is the second route.
firstCall: playwright --version, or google-chrome --version, to confirm a browser is present
evidenceNote: On 2026-11-23 the example brand specimen was captured from a file URL: Playwright 1.63 full-page at 390 px wide with the dark color scheme, and Chrome --headless=new at 390 and 1440 px wide. Each run wrote a PNG of the asked width. No network was used. A page that sets its theme with a data-theme attribute ignores the color-scheme flag; that case needs a script or a query parameter.
